_comment: Actor Factory convention, not read by Apify. After the owner merges, the Publisher creates this pricing on Apify while the Actor is private, with Bronze/Silver/Gold discounts from config.yaml unless tiersPer1000Usd is set, and later only ever lowers it. Results are charged with Apify's synthetic per-item event, so keep no other per-result event.

apify-default-dataset-item.description: One result written to the dataset.
